title: Correct premature scope freeze based on human-hour assumptions
description: Record the actual user correction after the lead pushed toward the homework baseline and submission instead of continued iteration. Maintain a standing policy based on measured agent throughput, dependencies and actual constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Journal preserves the actual recommendation and user feedback without inventing internal reasoning or measured speedups.
AGENTS.md and the roadmap require continued iteration and remove an automatic human-hour-based freeze.
Remaining enhancements are a planned backlog rather than deferred solely for assumed lack of time.
test_cases: Review the journal against the actual exchange.
Inspect guide/roadmap and reopened issue statuses for consistency.
verification: Actual feedback recorded; iteration policy and roadmap corrected; enhancement planning reopened. Documentation change only.
